questions.question: Two groups in your class used different coding systems for the same question: Group A: 1 = Male, 2 = Female, 3 = Other Group B: 0 = Male, 1 = Female, 2 = Other What problem will this cause when combining both sets of data, and how will you solve it?
questions.solution_html:
• Understand the purpose – Identify what the company wants to find out through the
  • study.
  • Clarity: The question must be clear and easy to understand, leaving no confusion about
  • its meaning.
  • Formulating Define what the study aims to achieve, e.g., “To study customer
  • Objectives satisfaction” or “To identify factors affecting motivation.”
  • Personal Interview Data is collected through face-to-face interaction between
  • Survey interviewer and respondent.
